description: A C# game engine in which a program opens a window, draws each frame with plain static calls named as raylib's functions are, and draws Dear ImGui in the same frame, over SDL3, Vulkan and Slang, with an ECS and source-generated behaviors underneath.
releaseNotes:
The test of a pipeline's line asks its form and its one hash on every device and no hit of the driver's.
The second pipeline is asked to come from the cache only on a device whose cache keeps pipelines.
Each pipeline made is said in the log with whether the driver found it in the cache and a hash of its stages' bytes.
Each package is built at its own version, so its caches keep to a folder of their own, and other versions' folders no run used lately are swept.
The pipelines are written to their file on a worker, so the frames go on while the write waits and reads.
Pipelines made on several threads share the driver's cache at once, and the write alone holds it.
Ore turns and walks by fixed steps a frame and says its eye and target, so two runs repeat.
A probe's ray's hit takes each face of a far glow light as one point at its middle.
A screen probe no longer marches to a faint glow light that sends it nothing.
title: 3DEngine
